/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "fix: run session cleanup when setup fails" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
